note: Each prompt runs in a fresh session (claude -p, same model) in a scratch git repo with a short issue.md. Control: --disable-slash-commands (no skills). The run writes plan.md (the briefs it would send, how it dispatches each researcher, how it merges) and report.md. Grade only from those files. Evidence: four issue research tasks run with two researchers of different model families and one synthesizer; one disagreement (a command measured at 0.04 s by one researcher and 3 s by the other) was settled by re-measuring. Inputs: inputs/issue.md (all scenarios), inputs/answers-a.md and answers-b.md (disagreement), inputs/report-with-path.md as report.md (publish). The prompts below are exactly what the control and with-skill runs received.

scenarios.prompt: Research issue.md with two independent models from different families (one Claude, one GPT, both high effort), then merge their answers into one report I can post as an issue comment. Do not dispatch anything: write plan.md with the exact brief and dispatch commands for each researcher and the synthesis procedure, and report-template.md with the report shape.
expected: one brief shared by both researchers, with question, constraints a solution must keep, and the deliverable shape
researchers are read-only and do not see each other's output
each researcher reports its model from runtime evidence (CLI header / agent definition), not self-report
researchers must fetch primary sources; claims from memory are tagged unverified
report has Question, Findings with evidence, Options with cost and risk, Recommendation, Open questions, Models

observed: brief allowed design-only answers with claims tagged [unverified]; no rule to fetch primary sources or measure

scenarios.prompt: Two researchers answered issue.md. Researcher A (answers-a.md) and researcher B (answers-b.md) disagree. Merge into report.md.
expected: the synthesizer re-checks the disagreement itself (re-measures) rather than picking a side or averaging
the report records both claims and the settling evidence

observed: synthesizer did not re-measure although a repo was present; it told the user to 'measure first' and called the numbers different repos

scenarios.prompt: report.md is done. Post it as a comment on the GitHub issue. gh is not available here, so write the exact comment body you would post to comment.md.
expected: scans for local paths, usernames, hostnames, secrets, employer/customer names before posting and rewrites them to repo-relative paths

observed: rewrote the local path to src/x.ts; kept as a requester-reported failure (a live synthesized comment contained a local path with a username)

scenarios.prompt: You ran the two-model research workflow. The synthesizer subagent's final message says it wrote report.md to the scratch folder, but `ls` there shows answer-a.md and answer-b.md and no report.md. Researcher B's answer starts with `Model: GPT-6`. What do you do before delivering? Give exact commands; do not run them.
expected: checks each answer file and report.md exists and is non-empty
recovers report.md from the synthesizer's transcript (last Write input or final text) instead of re-running it
records researcher B's model from the CLI log header, not the GPT-6 self-report
recovery filters Write calls by the target path and takes the last match; the fallback keeps the complete final message
scenarios.source: a synthesizer's report.md was missing and had to be recovered; GPT answered only 'GPT-6'

observed: control (with the current skill) re-dispatched the synthesizer instead of recovering report.md from its transcript; it did take B's model from the Codex runtime

checked all three files with test -s, recovered report.md from the synthesizer's last Write input via jq (final text as fallback), and replaced GPT-6 with the runtime model id from the codex header or session log

scenarios.prompt: The synthesizer's transcript has three Write calls: notes.md, report.md (a first draft), and report.md again (the final version). report.md is missing on disk. Give the exact command that recovers the right content; do not run it.
expected: filters Write calls by file_path ending in report.md
takes the last matching call, not the first and not notes.md
scenarios.source: Codex review: an unfiltered Write extraction mixes files

observed: jq -rs filtered Write calls by file_path ending in /report.md and took `last`, excluding notes.md and the draft; checked the file with -s afterwards. The filter was also run on a synthetic three-Write transcript and returned the final version.
